note: Both sets capture the key figure values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0° = -25.52E+6 watt/rad, θ_k = 6.302336°) and the doubling relation of Eq. (7-17), and both share the same weaknesses: θ_k mislabeled as the best-fit 'intercept', several chart-read values (-30E+6, -90E+6, -120E+6) with fabricated quotes like 'Original Data point at x=0' that appear nowhere in the page, and quotes that are only axis labels. Set A adds four further bad claims absent from B: θ = 6.302336° bound to 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch Angle' and to 'Blade-Pitch Controller' (misbinding θ_k as a generic pitch angle), a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' claim for ∂P/∂θ with a truncated unit (watt/ra), and a garbled 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch | Sensitivity' claim. Since B is A minus these misbound/invented items and loses no correct fact, B is the cleaner, more faithful set.
